why: The ONE table of week boundaries, read by both suites. 'This week' is derived twice — backend/jobtracker/cloud/applications.py::_week_start and apps/web/lib/dashboard/age.ts::weekStartOf — and the two cannot share an implementation across Python and TypeScript. They can be made to fail together, and this file is how: backend/tests/test_this_week_is_a_calendar_week.py and apps/web/tests/unit/week-boundary.test.mjs both assert exactly these rows. Editing one side's answer without the other is impossible, because there is only one answer to edit.
